title: OLYMPOX — Set up your influencer studio
inputHint: Choose a number or listed value. Enter accepts a displayed * default; the provider requires an explicit choice. Ctrl-C cancels before installation.
nodeRequired: Node 22 or later is required. Current runtime: {version}.
assistant: Which assistant will coordinate your studio?
provider: Which media provider do you choose? No provider is preselected.
higgsfieldDescription: Higgsfield — media modules for images, voice and video, each subject to access and capability checks
openrouterDescription: OpenRouter — Seedance 2.5 video with supported references; other media stages need a separate choice
higgsfieldPromptScope: Use its verified modules for the applicable media stages.
openrouterPromptScope: Use Seedance 2.5 for compatible video stages, preserving my selected visual and voice references. Ask me to choose the method for images, standalone voice and other unsupported stages.
outsideSource: Choose an independent directory outside the framework source checkout.
sourceFailed: The framework source is incomplete or unsafe: {reason} Retry setup from a repaired or freshly extracted framework package.
existingDirectory: This directory already contains files. How should installation proceed?
merge: Merge safely: retain identical files and refuse differences
conflictAction: Choose another directory or cancel. Existing files remain intact.
summaryLanguage: Setup language: {language}; canonical framework files and machine values remain English.
summaryFiles: Files: {copied} to install, {retained} identical files to retain, {total} total.
summaryVerification: After copying: build the manual, check installed instructions and skills, validate local records, and check manual freshness.
summaryProvider: Your {provider} choice is saved locally; media readiness remains pending. Installation does not connect accounts, upload references, generate media, train identities, or publish.
invalidChoice: Choose a listed number or value; Enter accepts the displayed default.
explicitChoice: Choose a listed provider explicitly; there is no default.
cancelled: Setup cancelled. No studio files were written.
nonTTY: Interactive setup requires a terminal. For automation, use setup <directory> --assistant codex|claude|both --provider higgsfield|openrouter --yes [--locale en|pt-BR] [--merge].
explicitRequired: --yes requires an explicit directory, --assistant codex|claude|both and --provider higgsfield|openrouter.
verified: Local installation checks passed. Provider connection and creative quality still require real checks in your assistant session.
verificationFailed: Studio files are installed and preserved. Local verification failed or was interrupted; rerun the check shown below.
fullVerify: For the complete framework test suite, run this command from {directory}:
openCodex: Open this directory in Codex and invoke $olympox.
openClaude: Open this directory in Claude Code and invoke /olympox.
hostNote: Host installation and live skill discovery are separate. If the chosen assistant is not installed here, install or open it later; these local files remain ready.
prompt: Atena, let's create my first original influencer. Propose three distinct concepts and recommend one. I selected {provider}. {scope} Check access and the complete pilot's reference transfer, voice, video, export, inspection and budget before production.
